display_name: 导师补实验：四种完整半监督对比方法
description: 24 个数据设置 × RIEI、DRIFT、IB-RFF、SDG，沿用完整方法加普通 PL 和三场景源增强。与自适应 Tri 在相同角色及测试样本配对。
authorization: 2026-11-24 用户要求跑 Word 导师提出的补实验

code.commit: Git commit stored in dispatch runtime
code.checkout: Frozen Full D recipe 07ada6b251f049573c0c4013c66a6c91830919a3 and advisor adapter

data.version: 20261023 retained eq1 role and fixed IQ caches
data.leo_config_ref: Locked seven Phase1 practical-residual views in the October paper context

permissions.claim_scope: Phase1 closed-set frozen DG on terrestrial IQ with simulated practical impairments

checkpoint.initialization: Scratch for each method and data setting; IB-RFF stage2 legally inherits its own same-row stage1.
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Frozen historical weights used only for one source-only smoke on their original source contract.
checkpoint.selection_rule: Original Full D rule. RIEI/DRIFT final fixed budget, IB-RFF/SDG source V NLL; no target feedback.

execution.gpu_policy: GPU0–7, one worker from this run per card, 3400 MiB free at dispatch, one independent CPU scorer, one source augmentation producer
execution.stop_rule: On the first technical failure stop new dispatch while existing workers finish; do not use target metrics.

metrics_plan.scorer_ref: Independent truth-last Phase1 scoring, same clean and six practical views
